name: Crisps
steps: Open a single 25 g bag; that is the portion, and ready salted keeps it vegan.
If you only have a sharing bag, tip a handful into a bowl and clip the bag shut before you start eating.

name: Mixed nuts

ingredients.display: a small handful of mixed nuts (30 g)

steps: Portion 30 g into a pot or a hand rather than eating from the bag, which is very easy to empty.
Store somewhere cool and dark; nuts pick up other smells and turn rancid if they sit open for months.

name: Olives
steps: Drain a small bowlful from the jar and keep a dish handy for the stones.
Leave the rest submerged in their brine in the fridge and they will keep for weeks after opening.

name: Pork scratchings

ingredients.display: 1 small bag of pork scratchings (25 g)

steps: Eat from a small single bag; they are very salty and rich, so one bag goes a long way.
Check for hard pieces if you have dodgy teeth, and have a glass of water alongside.

name: Salted peanuts

ingredients.display: a small handful of salted peanuts (30 g)

steps: Shake a small handful into a bowl and put the jar away; 30 g is about as much as fills a cupped palm.
Keep the lid on tight, as they go soft and stale within days once opened.

name: Salted popcorn
steps: Heat the oil in a lidded pan, add the kernels, cover and shake now and then until the popping slows to a few seconds apart.
Tip out straight away and salt lightly; 20 g of kernels fills a large bowl, so it looks far more generous than it is.
